patches_added.name: Appear on top (legacy)
patches_added.description: Legacy overlay-permission fallback retained for older Steam Link builds. Adds SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW and the compositor signal window.

patches_added.name: Galaxy XR high-resolution 3-projection fix
patches_added.description: Recommended 5002322-only permission-free resolution fix. Preserves Valve's native 3 projections and source formats, including future RGB10_A2, while appending a static 2x2 Android-surface compositor trigger with no image copy or reconstruction.

patches_removed.name: Appear on top
patches_removed.description: Adds SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW to the manifest so GalaxyXRPermissionActivity can request overlay permission at startup.

patches_modified.name: Change package name
patches_modified.description: Renames the manifest package and Steam Link's internal VR-launch component so the patched app can coexist with the original installation.

patches_modified.name: Force HMD initialization gates
patches_modified.description: Bypasses the two verified capability gates in QSVLDeviceHmd::Init for Steam Link builds 5001740, 5002244, and 5002313.

patches_modified.name: Force lobby permission-state gate
patches_modified.description: Bypasses the verified permission-state gate in XrSceneLobby for Steam Link builds 5001740, 5002244, and 5002313.

patches_modified.name: Force stream XR gates
patches_modified.description: Bypasses the three verified XR gates in builds 5001740 and 5002244. Build 5002313 rewrote XrSceneStream::Init and is intentionally left unchanged.

patches_modified.name: OLED color calibration
patches_modified.description: Calibrates Galaxy XR OLED color and selects a guarded high-precision video output path for Steam Link builds 5001740, 5002244, 5002313, 5002318, and 5002322.

patches_modified.name: XR Launcher Bootstrap (Home Space)
patches_modified.description: Installs GalaxyXRPermissionActivity as launcher and configures the Steam Link VR activity XR startup wiring.
